newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar ends a bit lower in shortened session.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar ends a bit lower in shortened session.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures ended slightly weaker Tuesday in a shortened Christmas Eve session.

Prices stayed within a relatively narrow band throughout the session, which lasted just under two hours. Speculators bought the market at the open, but both the trade and commission houses sold toward the highs when no follow-through interest emerged.
"Specs bought it up to the highs early, and then it ran out of gas," said one broker. "There was no real feature today."
Most-active March eased 0.02 cent per lb on the day, to 10.73, having traded from 10.72 to 10.79. May slipped 0.01, to 10.80. A scant 1,922 lots were exchanged.
Technically, traders put resistance toward today's high of 10.79, with support seen in the low 10.60s.
The CSCE will be closed Wednesday, December 25, and Thursday, December 26, in observance of Christams.
-- Wendy Pollack, New York Commodities Desk +1 212 859 1640
